description: Starter multimodal evaluation set for VLM benchmarking on EU-FarmBook style agricultural imagery. Drop image files into image_root and reference by image_filename.

items.question: What weed species are visible in this cereal field, and what non-chemical control options would you recommend?
Looking at the soil surface in this image, what indicators of soil health or degradation can you identify, and what restoration steps would you suggest?
What signs of drought or heat stress can you see in this crop, and what climate adaptation practices could mitigate them in a Mediterranean context?
Identify the symptoms visible on these leaves and suggest an integrated pest management response.
What kind of pest damage is visible on this maize, and which IPM steps would you take to manage it?
